title.narrative: Road Network Development Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative:
Project 1 of the Road Network Investment Program aims to develop an adequate, efficient, safe, and sustainable road network, linking the country domestically and internationally.
Project 1 has four components: (i) construction of about 22.1 km of a new expressway between Masalli and Astara on the southern corridor, (ii) rehabilitation of local roads in the project area and along East-West highway, (iii) installation of four vehicle weighing stations in selected locations, and (iv) project support and capacity building for road network management.

title.narrative: 02 Oct 2007 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/adb-approves-500m-loan-facility-azerbaijans-road-network-program
Loan 2354: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Loan 2355: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024

Progress Toward Outcome: The final review mission was fielded on 28-30 Aug, 2017. The Section A of the road has been fully completed. The taking over certificate was issued on Aug 19, 2017
A review mission was fielded on 1-9 March 2017 to review the implementation progress of ongoing road works and agree with the government a time-bound action plan to improve the portfolio performance.
Cumulative progress for Section A is about 90.84% completed as of 27 February 2017. The four (4) weighbrige stations have been installed. Lenkaran Bridge was completed and the taking-over certificate was issued in September 2014.
ADB approved the governments request to extend Tranche 1 loan closing date to 28 September 2017 to fully complete the road works for Section A.
Some results are in the Environmental and Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2018: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/39176/39176-023-emr-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jun 2011: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//39176-02-aze-rp-02.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The mission facilitated communication between AYY and ALG consultant to reach agreement to reach final agreement on settling the long outstanding issue regarding additional study for R6 road. The issue expected to be settled
before closing date.
The original civil works contract for Section A with AzerinshaatService LLC was terminated on 14 October 2015 with about 66% completion of physical progress. The direct contracting with Kolin Insaat Turizm Sanayi ve Tic A.S. for the balance work was approved and contract was signed on 24 June 2016.
As of March 2017, 21.3 km out of the entire 22.1 km road section has completed all asphalt works and the paving of asphalt wearing course on the remaining 800 meter is ready to start once weather condition allows. The remaining works concerning mainly road furniture installations and few bridge approaches on the access roads are being carried out.
Cumulative progress for Section A is about 97.1% completed as of 30 June 2017. AAY exerting best efforts to achieve target.
The study on 'Legal and Regulatory Framework for Toll Roads' completed in Nov 2013 and the final report was submitted by the consultants in April 2014.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/39176-023/main#project-tenders
